name: tokens
title: dfdl tokens
author: Dylan Fernandez de Lara
description: The dfdl design tokens: OKLCH primitives and semantics, light and dark, two approved accents, quiet mode. tokens.css for Tailwind v4 projects; tokens.hsl.css (HSL channel triples) for Tailwind v3. Generated from decisions in dylanfernandezdelara/dfdl-ui.
docs: Set the accent once on the root: <html data-accent="ember"> (default) or "indigo". Add data-quiet for data-dense products. Tailwind v4: map the semantics into @theme inline as in https://github.com/dylanfernandezdelara/dfdl-ui/blob/main/src/app/globals.css. Tailwind v3: point your theme colors at hsl(var(--hsl-bg-page) / <alpha-value>) from tokens.hsl.css. Guide: https://ui.dylanfdl.com/guide
